title: An AI platform is coming
summary: The Lab's head (coherence pass 3): a 120px two-line h1, “An AI platform / is coming.”, the light accent the word “coming.” (D4); lede “It will cover GTM, revenue strategy and revenue architecture. The Lab’s first benchmark is due in Q4 2026.”; phone floor 48 (40 below 360); the plate is the Revenue Entropy Index's cover as a whole sheet, “Not yet published”, its year at .9 of the h1.
story: Answers the visitor's first question ('is there anything here yet?') honestly: something is coming, and it is an AI platform. The lede says who builds it and for what (Q4: the Lab, our R&D; GTM, revenue strategy and revenue architecture). The shot card shows nothing on purpose: the brief is a screen too far out of focus to read, which is the tease and is also true (no instrument is named, nothing runs yet).
copy: [K, Q4] h1 “Coming soon: / an AI platform.” (accent: “Coming soon:”, the founder's ‘coming soon’; the subject is his ‘AI intelligence platform’)
[K, Q4] lede “The Lab, our R&D, is building it for GTM, revenue strategy and revenue architecture.” (no noun phrase of the h1 repeated)

[N] shot card: slate “Footage to come” · “The first build, out of focus.” · “Filmed the day it first runs: one screen in a dark room, focus pulled until nothing on it reads.” · spec “8 s · 2.52 : 1” (numerals and units only; the plate's own aspect, 1312 × 520)
Nav: four items, The Firm lit (The Lab sits in The Firm's plate, Q4).
phone: Kit composition: the h1 holds at 56px at 390 and 320 and wraps by phrase ('Coming / soon: / an AI / platform.'; every word fits a 288px line), the lede takes the full measure at 17px, the shot card grows with its words (min 240px): slate, then the brief, then the spec line at its foot.

reference.site: GoNimbly (the founder's recordings, refs-r9): Careers and Solutions heads
reference.borrowed: A short headline, a line or two of lede, and one big picture directly under the head at full width; the picture carries the page, the type stays calm.
reference.kelwin: Kit §12.3/12.4: two-voice h1 with the 48×2 rule, cast 128/stacked with the accent leading (Insights, the other 128, ends on its accent); the picture is a shot card on flat graphite (no footage exists yet), labelled 'Footage to come', no take number, no timecode.

motion: entrance (kit §13): the turn lifts, the h1 writes itself in ('Coming soon:' in the light voice, then 'an AI platform.'), the rule draws and the lede rises, then the shot card rises as a narrower rectangle and widens to the measure.
notes: Coherence pass 2: the viewfinder card “The first build, out of focus.” is replaced by the Index's cover as a sheet plate (its brief goes to the founder's shot list); the-lab-index no longer repeats the cover and is retired from the page order. h1 “Software for / the whole revenue system.” (whole-line accent) → “An AI platform / for revenue teams.”. Round 8's head is gone: 'The instruments / under the service.', the R&D crumb, the Status/Access/Your data facts box with its IN DEVELOPMENT chip, and the five-bar status board (Q4: no instruments to name). Round 9's first cast, 'Coming / by invitation.', had no subject and left 'by' alone at 320; 'by invitation' now lives in the close. Page CSS: the shot card's brief sits under the slate, and the spec line keeps its units in lower case ('8 s', not '8 S'); both are kit requests. The shot card's copy is a brief for the founder to confirm or rewrite. Coherence pass (round 9): see summary. Coherence pass 3: h1 recast: “An AI platform / for revenue teams.” broke into four lines with two lone words at 390. The lede no longer shares the GTM Intelligence pointer's frame (“Our R&D, the Lab, is building…”). The cover year follows the h1 (108px at 1440, 82 at 1024, 67 at 834, 41 at 390) — at 116/96 it outranked the fluid h1 on tablets and phones. Final check: the lede no longer reads as a Q4 2026 date for the platform (‘…, and its first benchmark is due…’, where ‘its’ was the platform): it is now two sentences, “It will cover GTM, revenue strategy and revenue architecture. The Lab’s first benchmark is due in Q4 2026.”, so the date belongs to the Lab's benchmark (as on Insights and Contact) and the platform stays undated.
